description: The root HTML element a component renders. Div (the default) keeps a component's historical block root; Span promises a phrasing root and subtree, so the component may sit inside phrasing content such as a whole-card link or button.

members.name: Div
members.description: Renders a <div> — the historical root of TmSparkline and TmSkeleton, so a host that never sets Element renders exactly what it rendered before.

members.name: Span
members.description: Renders a <span>, i.e. a phrasing root and a phrasing subtree. Use it when the component lives in a link, a button or another element that allows phrasing content only (the whole-card target of TmStatCard does).
